summary: Replica and source envelope decoding, protobuf wire limits and exact journal framing.

ignore-delimited-length.defect: A short length-delimited field is clipped to the available bytes.

mutate.find: if body > available || length > (available - body) as u64 { return None; }
mutate.replace:
if body > available { return None; }
    if length > (available - body) as u64 { return Some(available); }

stop-after-external-field.defect: A recognized external payload hides a malformed suffix.

mutate.replace: if field == 8 && wire == 2 { return Ok((true, cursor)); }

drop-group-depth-check.defect: Nested groups can recurse past the protobuf depth ceiling.

mutate.replace: if depth == usize::MAX {
invariant start <= cursor, depth < usize::MAX, wire == 3,

no-progress-in-group.defect: Group traversal processes the same nested field without advancing.

mutate.find: cursor = skip_wire(bytes, nested_field, nested_wire, next, depth + 1)?;
mutate.replace: let _ = skip_wire(bytes, nested_field, nested_wire, next, depth + 1)?;

expect.category: decreases not satisfied at end of loop

discard-high-key-bits.defect: A key beyond the maximum field number can alias an in-range field.

mutate.replace: let field = (key as u32) as u64 / 8;

ignore-located-trailing-bytes.defect: A single-record payload location can contain a suffix outside its declared body.

mutate.find: if !matches_body(body_len(&body), length as usize, checksum(&body), expected_checksum) { return None; }
mutate.replace: if !matches_body(body_len(&body), length as usize, checksum(&body), expected_checksum) && body_len(&body) <= length as usize { return None; }

decode-torn-stream-body.defect: A journal reader shortens the declared length and tries to decode the shorter body.

mutate.find: let Some(end) = frame_size(remaining, length) else { return Ok(None); };
mutate.replace:
let length = if length > 0 { length - 1 } else { 0 };
    let Some(end) = frame_size(remaining, length) else { return Ok(None); };

ignore-body-checksum.defect: A whole body can be accepted without its checksum matching the header.

mutate.replace: available == declared

short-frame-size.defect: Frame sizing computes an off-by-one byte span for a nonempty journal body.

mutate.replace: let end = 8 + (if length > 0 { length - 1 } else { 0 }) as u64;

write-uncertified-activation.defect: A certified record is dropped instead of framed.

mutate.replace:
if record.certified { return; }
    encode_frame(buffer, &record);

discard-stream-certification.defect: A sequential journal read clears the record's certification bit.

mutate.replace: Ok(Some((Record { certified: false, ..record }, end as u64)))

discard-located-certification.defect: A read at a retained record location clears the certification bit.

mutate.replace:
let record = decode_record(body)?;
    Some(Record { certified: false, ..record })

discard-round-trip-certification.defect: The composed writer and located reader return a record with its certification bit cleared.

mutate.replace:
let decoded = decode_located_record(&bytes)?;
    Some(Record { certified: false, ..decoded })

discard-replica-term.defect: Decoding an encoded replica envelope replaces its term with a default.

mutate.find: let term = match term { Some(term) => term, None => 0 };
mutate.replace: let term = 0;

drop-refusal-prefix-check.defect: An RTDB extension replica record is accepted without its XTDB refusal prefix.

mutate.replace: if header == PROTOBUF_LOG_HEADER || header == RTDB_EXTENSION_LOG_HEADER { return Ok(payload); }

reverse-external-classification.defect: The envelope substitutes the opposite of the completed scan's answer.

mutate.replace: Ok(!found)

discard-decoded-envelope-term.defect: The decoded frame loses its retained term when converted into an envelope.

mutate.find: Some(message) => Some(ReplicaEnvelope { term: self.term, term_sequence: self.term_sequence, message }),
mutate.replace: Some(message) => Some(ReplicaEnvelope { term: Term(0), term_sequence: self.term_sequence, message }),

omit-encoded-source-body.defect: A source protobuf encode loses the message it must round-trip.

mutate.replace: SourceMessage::Protobuf(_) => Ok(join_bytes(&[], &[])),

drop-legacy-source-header.defect: The stored legacy transaction loses its original header in the decoded value.

mutate.replace: SourceMessage::LegacyTransaction(legacy_source(payload))

bypass-replica-stage.defect: An invalid timed stage may enter a decoded replica frame.

refuse-encoded-retirement.defect: A canonical tagged retirement no longer round-trips.

mutate.find: let prefix: &[u8] = if retirement { RETIREMENT_MARKER } else { &[] };
mutate.replace: let prefix: &[u8] = if retirement { &[] } else { &[] };

classify-plain-as-retirement.defect: The exact untagged attempt is reported as a retirement.

mutate.replace: Ok(attempt) => Ok((attempt, true)),

change-log-version-byte.defect: The protobuf framing header changes its wire identity.

mutate.replace: pub const PROTOBUF_LOG_HEADER: u8 = 5;

change-extension-header-byte.defect: The RTDB extension framing header changes its wire identity.

mutate.replace: pub const RTDB_EXTENSION_LOG_HEADER: u8 = 5;

change-retirement-marker.defect: The fixed retirement marker changes its wire identity.

mutate.replace: b"rtdb/placed-receipt-retirement/v2\0";
